prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1500; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a low-speed head-on collision. Our client has sought medical treatment for injuries arising from this incident, and their recovery is ongoing. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, to this office rather than to our client.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter so that our file may be properly maintained.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, repair and salvage records, witness statements, dashcam or surveillance footage, and all claim notes and adjuster files. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, repaired, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
